title: wissadula periplocifolia var. luciana
intro: Wissadula periplocifolia var. luciana, commonly known as the Luciana wissadula, is a species of flowering plant in the family Malvaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Latin America, due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Wissadula periplocifolia var. luciana include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of this plant may also contribute to its potential as an anti-cancer agent, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
